test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following states hosted the 9th World Ayurveda Congress & Arogya Expo in December 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Goa__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Goa will host the 9th World Ayurveda Congress & Arogya Expo from December 8-11, 2022.
 
• ‘Ayurveda for One Health’ is the focal theme of the event.
 
• It will be organized by the World Ayurveda Foundation, an initiative by Vijnana Bharati.
 
• Seven plenary sessions, 16 themes for oral presentation, a string of associated events, and public outreach programs will dominate the proceedings of the conclave.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• ​Ministry of AYUSH celebrates Ayurveda Day every year on Dhanvantari Jayanti and this year it will be celebrated on 23 October.
 
• The Ministry of Ayush, a ministry of the Government of India, is responsible for developing education, research, and propagation of traditional medicine systems in India.
 
 
• Founded: 9 November 2014
 
• Officeholder: Sarbananda Sonowal (Union Minister)
 
 

Goa:

 
• Founded: 30 May 1987
 
• Capital: Panaji 
 
• Governor: P.S. Sreedharan Pillai
 
• Chief minister: Pramod Sawant
